grounding.states: a dark, quiet room with the same short wind-down routine each time helps a child nap
putting him down while he is sleepy, before he is overtired, helps

value.answer: Usually it comes down to a dark, quiet room, the same short wind-down every time (a book, a song, lights low), and putting him down while he's sleepy rather than past it, since overtired kids often fight sleep harder. White noise can help too. How old is he? The tips shift a lot between a baby and a toddler.
